label: prf:topological-mass-dilogarithm
title: Proof of the quantum dilogarithm evaluation
html:
Proof. Proof of the quantum dilogarithm evaluation

Proof. The identification of each summand with the quantum dilogarithm \Phi_q(z_i) follows from the corollary below. Integrating the q-deformed expansion flow over the resolved defect E_i in the spectral coordinates of the Briggs--Klein chart yields \Phi_q(z_i) = \int_0^{z_i} \ln_q(1+t)/t\, dt. \square
